title: A one-time cloud-driven TOA step at the 1981 HadISST1-to-OI v2 splice explains the large AMIPII historical pattern effect in ECHAM6.3 runs; linear Green's functions miss the step
abstract: Question: the AMIPII SST dataset (HadISST1 to October 1981, NOAA OI SST v2 after) gives a much larger historical pattern effect than other SST datasets in atmosphere-model runs with pre-industrial forcing. This value enters climate-sensitivity estimates. What causes the AMIPII excess? Approach: we used the published ECHAM6.3 runs of Modak and Mauritsen (2023): seven SST datasets, five members each, 1871-2017, same sea ice. The AMIPII and HadISST1 runs have the same SST anomalies before November 1981. We fitted the step in top-of-atmosphere (TOA) net flux at the splice, removed it, and used member and block bootstraps. We applied six GFMIP Green's functions to the same SST, and examined the PCMDI-AMIP forcing files for CMIP6/CMIP7 (1.1.9/1.1.10) and CMIP7Plus (Had1p1, ERSST5, OI2p1). Results: the 1871-2017 feedback is -1.91 W m-2 K-1 with AMIPII and -1.46 to -1.73 with the other datasets (pattern effect 0.43 against 0.23 for HadISST1). The AMIPII-minus-HadISST1 TOA flux falls by 0.26 W m-2 (95% -0.33 to -0.19) at the splice and then stays constant, with +0.03 K global temperature change. Shortwave cloud effect gives the drop (-0.32 W m-2). Removal of this one step explains 124% (79-161%) of the feedback difference to HadISST1 and 112% (86-134%) of that to the mean of five other datasets. In the 1871-2010 window of Andrews et al. (2018), the pattern effect goes from 0.44 to 0.18 (HadISST1 0.16). After 1981 the two runs have the same feedback (-2.67, -2.63). The step makes the 1979-2014 (CMIP6 amip) feedback 0.12 more negative. Green's functions do not show the step: on the same SST they give -0.01 to -0.13 W m-2 (ECHAM6 -0.04), and their dataset feedbacks do not correlate with the model (r = -0.34 to 0.21). The CMIP7Plus OI2p1 prototype has a separate -0.125 K (60S-60N) SST step in September 1981. Limitations: one model; the SST feature that causes the step is not resolved; we do not know which dataset is correct in 1982; sea ice is AMIPII in all runs; pattern effects use one abrupt-4xCO2 value.

Left: 1871-2017 feedback of seven SST datasets in ECHAM6.3 and in Green's functions applied to the same SST; the open circle is AMIPII with the splice step removed. Right: the splice step in six Green's functions and in the full model.
